notes.title: Patch Notes - Version [1.0.12] - Save Fix
notes.notes:
Fix:

Improved Save Speed: We have fixed a bug that was causing long save times, improving the overall gameplay experience.

Acknowledgements:
We sincerely want to thank everyone for their patience while we worked on this issue. We know that inconveniences can affect the experience, and we truly appreciate your understanding.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused, and we remain committed to providing you with the best possible experience. Thank you for your continued support!
